notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.17.2. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `OccurrenceUsagePrefix ActionNodeUsageDeclaration?` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. Both parts can derive empty, so the prefix as a whole is optional in effect, which is why `if i < 0 {` needs nothing before the keyword. It is the shared head of the structured control nodes, where the node keyword follows it; the simpler control nodes use ControlNodePrefix instead, which is a different production.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.
Line 7 `if i < 0 {` and line 20 `while i > 0 {` each have an empty ActionNodePrefix before the node keyword.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
